```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant User
    participant Runner as TDDCycleRunner
    participant Pod as PythonLanguagePod
    participant Worker as WorkerAgent
    participant LLM as LLMClient
    participant Playbook as PlaybookManager
    participant Orch as PodmanOrchestrator
    participant Ctr as PodmanRunner
    participant Logger as ExperimentLogger
    participant Reflector
    participant Curator

    User->>Runner: run(spec)
    activate Runner
    Runner->>Pod: run_red(spec)
    activate Pod
    Pod->>Worker: generate_test(spec)
    activate Worker
    Worker->>LLM: generate(prompt)
    activate LLM
    LLM-->>Worker: test_code
    deactivate LLM
    Worker-->>Pod: test_code
    deactivate Worker
    Pod->>Pod: ImportFilter.check()
    Pod->>Orch: pulse({test_file: code})
    activate Orch
    Orch->>Ctr: send_pulse(files)
    activate Ctr
    Ctr-->>Orch: PhaseResult
    deactivate Ctr
    Orch-->>Pod: PhaseResult
    deactivate Orch
    alt SecurityBreach or ForbiddenImport
        Pod-->>Runner: red_result(passed=False, error="ForbiddenImport:...")
    else
        Pod-->>Runner: red_result
    end
    deactivate Pod

    alt RedAborted
        Runner->>Logger: log_cycle(red_result)
        activate Logger
        Logger-->>Runner: done
        deactivate Logger
        Runner-->>User: CycleResult(success=False)
        deactivate Runner
    else
        loop max_green_attempts
            Runner->>Pod: run_green(spec with error_feedback)
            activate Pod
            Pod->>Worker: generate_implementation(spec, error_output)
            activate Worker
            Worker->>LLM: generate(impl_prompt)
            activate LLM
            LLM-->>Worker: impl_code
            deactivate LLM
            Worker-->>Pod: impl_code
            deactivate Worker
            Pod->>Pod: ImportFilter.check()
            Pod->>Orch: pulse({test_file, impl_file})
            activate Orch
            Orch->>Ctr: send_pulse
            activate Ctr
            Ctr-->>Orch: PhaseResult
            deactivate Ctr
            Orch-->>Pod: green_result
            deactivate Orch
            Pod-->>Runner: green_result
            deactivate Pod
            alt green_result.passed or SecurityAbort
                Note right of Runner: exits loop if passed or abort
            else
                Runner->>Runner: set error_feedback = output
            end
        end
        alt GreenFailed
            Runner->>Logger: log_cycle(green_result)
            activate Logger
            Logger-->>Runner: done
            deactivate Logger
            Runner-->>User: CycleResult(success=False)
            deactivate Runner
        else
            Runner->>Pod: run_refactor(spec)
            activate Pod
            Pod->>Orch: pulse({test_file, impl_file})
            activate Orch
            Orch->>Ctr: send_pulse
            activate Ctr
            Ctr-->>Orch: PhaseResult
            deactivate Ctr
            Orch-->>Pod: refactor_result
            deactivate Orch
            Pod-->>Runner: refactor_result
            deactivate Pod

            Note right of Runner: Learning loop (only if green passed)
            Runner->>Reflector: reflect(task, gen_output, env_feedback)
            activate Reflector
            Reflector-->>Runner: reflector_output
            deactivate Reflector
            Runner->>Curator: curate(reflector_output, playbook_id)
            activate Curator
            Curator->>Playbook: apply_delta(delta_bullets)
            activate Playbook
            Playbook-->>Curator: added_bullets
            deactivate Playbook
            Curator-->>Runner: curator_output
            deactivate Curator
            Runner->>Logger: log_cycle(with learned_bullets)
            activate Logger
            Logger-->>Runner: done
            deactivate Logger
            Runner-->>User: CycleResult(success)
            deactivate Runner
        end
    end
```
